items.title: General Motors (GM) Bets On Michigan Manufacturing And A New Equinox EV
items.summary: President Trump visited a General Motors (NYSE:GM) facility in Michigan, highlighting tariffs and US manufacturing during the 2026 election season. The visit drew attention to GM's emphasis on domestic production and its evolving approach to electric vehicles. Separately, GM outlined an upcoming update to the Chevy Equinox EV that will use a new platform with expanded capabilities. items.title: Is This Wall Street Bank Insane to Believe Tesla Will Nearly Double From Current Prices? Maybe Not.
items.summary: Wedbush just slapped a $600 price target on a stock that missed earnings by nearly 40% and watched its operating margin crater to almost nothing. The audacity either marks a Wall Street analyst losing the plot or someone who sees a business model transformation the rest of the market is too impatient to price in.
